annotations.text:
DinkyDash — ongoing settings, mobile (390×844)

The hub at top-left is the whole map: every row is one settings section, and each row's subtitle carries live state so problems surface before you tap in. Static mockups; nothing is clickable.

Chore rotation was undefined when these were drawn. Proposal: an explicit ordered list plus a next-week preview, so the day-of-year modulo is visible rather than mysterious. Reordering takes effect tomorrow — today's dashboard is already written.
The three states the calendars table implies: healthy, consecutive_failures > 0, and enabled = false. The failure card explains the likely cause and offers exactly one fix.
Still open: no drag-reorder interaction is drawn (the Reorder affordance is a placeholder), and lapse behaviour after trial isn't shown — it was an open question when these were drawn.

Light/Dark lives here rather than in Account: it is a property of the screen on the wall, not of the person editing. An Auto option (dark after sunset, using the family timezone) would suit a kitchen dashboard — not drawn, say the word.

Activity is for a parent. Streaks and a thirty-day grid per person sit above the one list that needs action: every due task left unticked in the last fourteen days, newest first, each with a single Tick button. The grid is a square per day (green done, ring something left, grey nothing due) with no red and no scolding, matching the wall's neutral treatment of missed tasks. Nothing older than fourteen days can be ticked, and nothing later than today.
